div.head: Quadr II Praef 5
div.ab: Hinc a primeuo mundi nascentis exordio quos rerum Deus artifex equa libertate ditauerat, inobedientie motus inflammantis eiecit; et qui celi Dominum ferre non poterant, hominum seruiunt prauitate distincti, continuis malorum prosecutionibus in deteriora queque proiecti.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 542–543 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: Hence, from the first beginning of the newborn world, those whom God the maker of things had enriched with equal liberty, the impulse of inflaming disobedience cast out; and those who could not bear the Lord of heaven serve men, set apart by their depravity, cast by continual pursuits of evils into everything worse.
